Google Analytics sets this cookie to calculate visitor, session and campaign data and track site usage for the site's analytics report. The cookie stores information anonymously and assigns a randomly generated number to recognise unique visitors.

6 months

Hubspot set this main cookie for tracking visitors. It contains the domain, initial timestamp (first visit), last timestamp (last visit), current timestamp (this visit), and session number (increments for each subsequent session).

HubSpot sets this cookie to keep track of the visitors to the website. This cookie is passed to HubSpot on form submission and used when deduplicating contacts.

# Wendover Woods

**Waymarked walks of different lengths through scenic woodland with a popular play trail, café, information, cycling, fitness trail and lots more.**

Wendover Woods is a 325 hectare open access woodland site managed by Forestry England. It is situated on the edge of the Chilterns escarpment and is a great place to take the family, with a popular play trail, a café, children’s adventure playground and a fitness trail. For those that fancy a challenge there is also the [Go Ape](https://www.chilterns.org.uk/map_marker/go-ape-wendover-woods/) high wire forest adventure.

Wendover Woods has year-round interest, from beautiful displays of bluebells in the spring to barbecues and picnics in the summer followed by swathes of autumn colours as the trees turn and crisp winter walks. In quieter areas you can watch woodland birds, including the rare firecrest if you’re lucky and you may see deer. There is also archaeological interest in the form of Boddington hillfort and the Woods contain the highest point in the Chilterns (267m).

**Firecrest Trail:** A 3 mile signposted trail through the habitat of the firecrest, Europe’s smallest bird. There is also a bird hide on the trail, set high amongst the trees for a better glimpse of the elusive firecrest.

**Family Cycle Trail:** A well surfaced trail with climbs and descents. There is a dedicated [downhill mountain biking facility](http://www.rideastonhill.co.uk/) at nearby Aston Hill for mountain bikers wanting a challenge ( **Please note: Aston Hill is currently closed and is due to reopen in spring 2026. Please check the [Forestry England website](https://www.forestryengland.uk/aston-hill-bike-park) for more and latest information**).

**Easy Access Trail:** see downloadable map below **.**

**Horse riding:** there is an extensive network of permissive bridlepaths within the woods, see [Horse riding at Wendover Woods](https://www.forestryengland.uk/wendover-woods/horse-riding-wendover-woods) for more information.

**Go Ape:** a high wire adventure course through the trees open to adults and over-10’s. A great, fun challenge with tarzan swings and thrilling zip wires to add to the excitement! And you get to see the Woods from a whole new viewpoint.

[More information](https://www.forestryengland.uk/wendover-woods)

### Nearby walks and cycling routes

**[Views of the Vale Walks](https://www.chilterns.org.uk/map_marker/chilterns-country-views-of-the-vale-walks/) –** circular walks from the centre of Wendover up to Wendover Woods and Coombe Hill.

[**Chilterns Cycleway**](https://www.chilterns.org.uk/map_marker/chilterns-cycleway/)

[**Icknield Way Trail**](https://www.chilterns.org.uk/map_marker/icknield-way-trail/) – walking, cycling and riding route.

##### Postcode

HP22 5NQ

##### Accessibility/terrain/walk info

There are many paths with hard surfaces including a waymarked easy access trail suitable for wheelchairs and buggies. There is a wheelchair accessible toilet opposite the café.

[Access Guide: Wendover Woods](https://www.chilterns.org.uk/accessibility-hub/explore-accessible-places/access-guides-videos/wendover-woods-access-trail/)

##### Facilities & accessibility

Cafe, toilets, BBQ pits, childrens play area, fitness trail. Network of paths and waymarked trails

Walk leaflets and a Wendover Woods map showing the various trails can be downloaded from the [Forestry England](https://www.forestryengland.uk/wendover-woods "Forestry Commission site") website. Leaflets are also available from Wendover Tourist Information centre.

Find lots more walks in Buckinghamshire at [http://www.walkinginengland.co.uk/bucks](http://www.walkinginengland.co.uk/bucks)

Dogs on leads in the core area.

##### More info
